subject: Microburst end-of-quarter consumption credit for Novatek pilot
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-28 09:12 -0700
Subject: Microburst end-of-quarter consumption credit for Novatek pilot

Team — quick ask for approval this week. Novatek (Arjun Shah) is in the final internal review to convert a 90-day pilot to a 6-month committed contract. Their projected committed consumption is $60k over 6 months, with an expected first-month ramp of ~30% of that. They like the runtime and the cost profile, but procurement asked for a one-off consumption credit to justify the first-month spend during their internal Q3 close.

Proposal: one-time consumption credit of $9,000 (applied as token/usage credit on the first invoice) + standard terms. Rationale: secures immediate commit and a 6-month ARR of $60k; expected churn risk is low given integration timelines. Without the credit they will likely push to a lighter commitment or delay signing until mid-Oct, which risks losing momentum into the new quarter.

Ask: approval to grant the $9k promotional credit and permission to send an updated term sheet (attached) and DocuSign link to Arjun today. If approved, I’ll kick off legal/finance flow and mark the HubSpot deal with the promo code.

Attached: novatek-consumption-term-sheet.pdf (one-page credit terms).

Thanks — Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-28 11:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Microburst end-of-quarter consumption credit for Novatek pilot

Kimberly — thanks for the write-up. Quick questions before I sign off:
- Can you confirm the exact ARR uplift and 12-month projected spend if they renew at the same rate after 6 months?
- Has the customer explicitly requested $9k or did we propose that number?

My gut: $9k is reasonable for $60k booked, but given the Q3 timing we could try to negotiate to $8k and keep some margin for future concessions. If you can share the customer acceptance language and the delta if we offered $8k vs $9k, I’ll weigh in formally.

— Ben
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-28 13:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Microburst end-of-quarter consumption credit for Novatek pilot

Thanks Ben — quick follow-up with numbers.
- 6-month committed: $60,000 (monthly: $10,000 avg; month 1 expected ~30% of total = ~$18k consumption).
- 12-month projection (conservative renew): $120,000 ARR if they expand post pilot.
- Customer did not name a number; procurement asked us to propose a consumption uplift to offset first-month consumption and internal approvals. I suggested $9k based on similar prior pilots where customers expected a ~15% subsidy of the first month.

Impact of $8k vs $9k:
- $8k: still gets to roughly the same paperwork acceptance probability; small risk they push back for full ask.
- $9k: better optics for procurement and reduces negotiation cycles; incremental cost to us is $1k.

I’m recommending $9k given the conversion probability and the revenue profile. I’ve attached an updated one-page term sheet with the credit language and expiration (must sign by Oct 6). I’ll include the customer acceptance snippet when I send the DocuSign.

Attached: novatek-consumption-term-sheet.pdf (v2).

On Thu, Sep 28, 2027 at 09:40 AM Arjun Shah <arjun@novatek.com> wrote:
> Kimberly — we’re happy with the pilot results. Procurement asked if Redwood can help with a first-month uplift to get internal approval. If you can put a one-time consumption credit on the table and lock pricing for 6 months, we’re ready to move fast.

— Kimberly
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-29 10:16 -0700
Subject: Re: Microburst end-of-quarter consumption credit for Novatek pilot

Kimberly / Ben — I’m comfortable approving a $9,000 one-time consumption credit on the conditions below:
1) Customer signs the updated term sheet by Oct 6 (include the exact language you attached).
2) Legal to do a quick risk review (no unusual data residency or SLA asks).
3) Finance to record the promo and confirm accounting treatment (credit on first invoice).

Kimberly — please route the DocuSign using the promo approval ticket template and CC Rishi. I’ll mark this as approved in the deal record and note the conditionality.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Arjun Shah <arjun@novatek.com>
Date: 2027-09-29 14:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Microburst end-of-quarter consumption credit for Novatek pilot

All — finance has processed the promo approval. Notes:
- Approved one-time consumption credit: $9,000 applied as usage credit to Novatek's first invoice upon activation.
- HubSpot deal D-2027-0928-078 updated with Promo ID: PROMO-2027-09-078.
- DocuSign link created: https://docusign.com/novatek-sign/abc123 (expires 10/06/2027).
- Internal ticket: PROMO-3421 created for tracking (redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROMO-3421).

Attached: promo-approval-note.txt (finance memo).

Arjun — we’ll send the DocuSign shortly; if you can confirm acceptance within 48 hours we’ll lock the credit. Thanks and welcome aboard.

— Rishi
Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
